title: On the Graphical $r$-Stirling Numbers of the First Kind for Specific Graph Families
summary: This paper investigates the \textbf{graphical $r$-Stirling numbers of the first kind}, denoted by $\str{G}{k}$, which enumerate partitions of a vertex set $V(G)$ into $k$ disjoint cycles such that $r$ specified vertices occupy distinct blocks. We establish closed-form expressions and recursive identities for fundamental graph families, including \textbf{Path} ($P_n$), \textbf{Cycle} ($C_n$), \textbf{Star} ($S_n$), \textbf{Wheel} ($W_n$), and \textbf{Fan} ($F_n$) graphs.
